reviewer: build-wave critique (code-grounded + real headless-Chrome probe evidence), revision 1

rubric.evidence: VERIFY-FIRST probe (real headless Chrome, repo CDP harness, dynamic import of the EXACT pinned CDN build @huggingface/transformers@3.7.5, fresh profile): pipeline('translation', 'Xenova/opus-mt-nl-en', {dtype:'q8', device:'wasm'}) loaded in 35.1s (cold download) and returned REAL translations — 'Ik ben dol op het webplatform en de browser.' → "I'm on the web platform and the browser."; 'De Europese Unie investeert miljarden euro in onderzoek en innovatie.' → 'The European Union invests billions of euros in research and innovation.' (~305 ms/inference warm, 0 console errors, 0 failed network requests). worker.js runs the same pipeline in a module worker off the main thread with a TextStreamer (greedy) — chunks, not subword tokens (3.7.5 flushes at whitespace boundaries; the pages say chunks).
rubric.notes: The pair IS the model — no src_lang/tgt_lang args, a genuine architectural contrast with the built m2m100/nllb-200/mbart-50 multilingual demos.

rubric.evidence: Expected output = translation_text string. worker.js returns {translation, pair, inTokens, outTokens, beams, ms} — real SentencePiece input_ids length + measured decode time. Probe outputs above are grammatical English preserving the Dutch meaning.
rubric.notes: Wild round-trip additionally loads the reverse pair Xenova/opus-mt-en-nl on demand (verified to exist on the Hub with 32 ONNX files, ungated).

rubric.evidence: At-a-glance declares Xenova/opus-mt-nl-en (linked, ONNX mirror of canonical Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-nl-en, Apache-2.0), the translation task, q8 dtype, WASM backend, ~115 MB (measured from the Hub blobs API: 53.9 MB encoder + 61.3 MB merged decoder). Loader call sites use the LITERAL model id 'Xenova/opus-mt-nl-en' on every route.
rubric.notes: Canonical repo + mirror + license all disclosed on the page and in models.json.

rubric.evidence: Every route uses the shared createModelLoader (lib/model-loader.js) for the primary pair — a valid current cached copy auto-initialises with no Load click; Download appears only when absent; clear-cache via the shared loader. The wild route's reverse pair loads on demand via the worker's ensure/pair-loading path with pair-ready confirmation (same pattern as the built marianmt-translation family).
rubric.notes: HONEST NUANCE (same as marianmt): the shared loader tracks the primary pair's cache; the reverse pair (~115 MB) downloads via the worker path with its own status line, disclosed on the wild page.

rubric.evidence: Progress via the shared loader's model-download-status component; empty-input and inference failures surface in a role=status aria-live=polite region with .status.err styling; controls disabled until onReady.
rubric.notes: No WebGPU requirement (WASM-only model), so no needs-WebGPU state is needed; honest too-large handling is the shared loader's.

rubric.evidence: Every visible control (sample chips, textarea, Translate/Localise/Round-trip buttons) is a native labelled element, keyboard-operable, disabled pre-ready. Sample chips fill the textarea (user still presses Translate).
rubric.notes: Controls verified by the route-complete validator on desktop + mobile.

rubric.evidence: All output comes from the worker's pipeline result or stream; the drift similarity is a computed word-Jaccard over the two REAL translations, labelled as such. No canned strings anywhere in the render path.

aria-live regions on status + output; labelled textarea/buttons; native elements throughout; design-system colors only (WCAG AA pairs). Guidance consulted: accessibility, forms, accessible-error-announcement.
rubric.notes: Focus order is source order; no dialogs/popovers in this family.

rubric.evidence: tr-io/controls-grid/stat-row use auto-fit minmax grids (no fixed columns); textarea inline-size:100%; viewport meta present. Guidance consulted: css-layout, form-fields-automatically-fit-contents. Verified by the validator at 1280×800 desktop and 360×740 DPR3 mobile.
Inference + tokenisation in a module worker; main thread only renders streamed chunks. Probe: ~305 ms warm inference for a 12-token sentence — well inside interactive budgets.
rubric.notes: Cold download ~35 s on the probe connection is a one-off, surfaced with real byte progress by the shared loader.
